abstract: Interested in taking the next step in your career in one of the world’s leading Chemical Engineering Departments? Join us to find out about the postgraduate opportunities offered by the Department of Chemical Engineering at Imperial College London. Situated at the heart of London, ranked the best student city in the world, Imperial College London is a global institution with a multicultural study environment and a vibrant student community. The event will include information on: 1. the 1-year MSc programmes in • Advanced Chemical Engineering • Advanced Chemical Engineering with Biotechnology • Machine Learning – Process Systems Engineering 2. the PhD programme that covers the broad range of research themes hosted by our Department; 3. the postgraduate admissions process for MSc and PhD studies; 4. the scholarship opportunities offered by our Department."
